name: thornton_patent_scan
one_line: Scan current platform documentation for cost features we are not using.
problem: Some savings are not in our transcripts at all: new caching options, cheaper model tiers, batching, context-editing or compaction tools, output limits.
design: Read the platform's release notes and pricing pages monthly (public documentation only).
For each feature, check whether our audited sessions pay for the thing it changes (cache writes, idle rebuilds, long outputs), using Hamilton's per-cause dollars.
Emit a candidate only when a feature touches a cause above 5% of some audited session; include the doc page name and the cause key.
The candidate's first test is the smallest A/B that turns the feature on for one task.
inputs: public release notes and pricing pages

cost_estimate.basis: one agent session reading roughly 10 documentation pages and 5 profiles per month
cost_estimate.note: Estimate only (unverified). Never counted as a saving.

first_test: If a caching or compaction feature exists, turn it on for one PR-babysit session and compare against the audited one.
risks: Feature claims are marketing until measured. Documentation changes; every candidate needs a dated page reference.
